_README: Source of the homeowner contact block that scripts/build_seller_contact_block.py
writes between the seller-contact markers on the pages listed below.
Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_seller_contact_block.py --write
scripts/dgp/test_seller_contact_block.py fails if a page drifts from this source.
Its word lists are a minimum check, not a complete one: a change to the copy
below needs a human review before release, whatever the gate reports.
phone_display / phone_tel: the line this block shows, dials and texts. The
public brokerage line is pending owner decision (see data/business-contact.json);
when it is set, change it here and in business-contact.json together.
sms_lines: the lines that show a Text action. The Text action texts the same
number as the Call action and appears only when phone_tel is listed here.
With the list empty the block offers call, email and CMA. Switching phone_tel
to an unlisted line removes the Text action by itself.
heading: Own a property in Queens?
intro: Ask us about its current market position. You don't have to be ready to list.
cma_label: Request a free comparative market analysis (CMA)
cma_note: A CMA is a licensed agent's opinion of value based on recent sales of similar properties. It is not an appraisal. There is no charge and no obligation to list.
